PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.capabilityScope: Player World Map and automatic Supply world teleport, while preserving city-local Supply and Quest navigation and rAthena authority

matureReferenceMatrix.currentGiCapability: Authenticated World Map selection currently invokes PA cross-map route coordinator; Native item-use and farm runtime already exist.
matureReferenceMatrix.openKoreCapability: processLockMap routes to a configured map; Task::Teleport handles item acknowledgment, timeout, retry and rejected use. It does not define GI paid World Map teleport.
matureReferenceMatrix.rAthenaCapability: pc_setpos decides relocation, map_getcell decides landing walkability, pc_payzeny and character status decide Zeny, PA command/state decide ownership and mode.
matureReferenceMatrix.otherMatureReference: NOT_APPLICABLE: no separate teleport runtime is authorized.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureExceptionBehavior: A rejected OpenKore teleport item attempt terminates that attempt without reporting relocation success; GI Fly Wing resumes bounded scanning.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureRecoveryBehavior: Existing PA tick/backoff remains the retry scheduler; failed World Map relocation preserves money and cooldown.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureConfigSemantics: Existing OpenKore route_teleport defaults remain reference-only; no OpenKore setting becomes a GI runtime dependency.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureUiSemantics: GI explicit product override adds one-click farm map selection and distinct major-town teleport; route eligibility text is superseded for this action.
matureReferenceMatrix.directReuse: Authenticated dashboard controller, PA command transport, map-info spawn classification, rAthena teleport/money/cell primitives, existing route engine for city-local Supply and Quest.
matureReferenceMatrix.adapt: A narrow Player teleport command and World Map coordinator replace manual farm-map route execution; the same authoritative teleport primitive handles Supply world return. Fly rejection returns to scan through existing tick.
matureReferenceMatrix.projectPolicy: Explicit user decision: 60-second shared per-character cooldown, level gate from minimum eligible normal farm monster, Lv<=66 free, higher-level cost minLevel*10, same-map no-op, towns free.
matureReferenceMatrix.improvements: Removes route-only farm-map exclusions while keeping authoritative server access restrictions and safe landing checks.
